thread:
Maria Chen: Morning handoff — I'm primary for 06:00-14:00 UTC. Quick summary of what happened overnight and current state.

ops-bot: ALERT INC-4587 — kv-eviction cascade detected on inference-pool-eu at 2026-03-26T03:12:41Z. Pages sent to @oncall-sre and @oncall-runtime.

Maria Chen: Timeline (brief):
- 03:12 UTC: spikes in kv eviction rate and per-token latency on eu cluster.
- 03:18 UTC: automatic fallback routing switched ~10% of traffic to smaller-quantized model variant to keep latency SLO.
- 03:30 UTC: autoscaler increased pool capacity by +12 GPUs; eviction rate trended down.
- 04:02 UTC: load stabilized; no new pages since 03:40.

Samir Ortiz: Observed symptoms: p95 for /v1/generate rose to ~1400ms, p50 stayed ~220ms. A couple of 503s at 03:15-03:22 from heavy eviction retries. No sustained 5xx after fallback.

Aj Patel: I'm secondary for this shift. Monitoring dashboards and logs. Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/eviction-dashboard (check panel: kv_eviction_rate, handler_errors).

June Park: Runbook pointer i've updated this morning: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction — includes immediate mitigation steps and escalation matrix.

Maria Chen: Quick excerpt of what I ran during mitigation (for traceability):
```bash
# check eviction metric (run from debug pod)
kubectl -n inference exec -it pod/metric-exporter -- curl -s localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_eviction_rate
# increase autoscaler min replicas as temporary mitigation
kubectl -n inference patch hpa inference-pool-eu -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 24}}'
# follow logs for failing batchers
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=batcher --since=30m | tail -n 200
```

infra-bot: DEPLOY NOTE model-optimizer v2.3.1 was deployed at 04:45 UTC to staging; flagged as unrelated to INC-4587.

Maria Chen: Customer impact: two trial customers (~0.3% of active requests) saw 500/503 errors during the 03:15-03:25 window. Support ticket created: #SUP-1293 and linked to INC-4587. No paid customers reported data loss.

Samir Ortiz: Initial root cause hypothesis: compressed KV cache eviction thrash due to a combination of long-tail sequences + a mis-tuned eviction threshold after recent mem-footprint reduction. Need to validate mem metrics across nodes and review recent memory optimizations.

Aj Patel: Current system status: stable. Eviction rate near baseline, autoscaler holding extra capacity for now. I have alerts set to watch for a regression:
- kv_eviction_rate > 0.5/s for 5m -> page primary
- generate_5xx_rate > 0.1% for 10m -> page primary+secondary

June Park: Short-term action items (assigned):
- Samir -> follow up on root cause and PR reverting the last mem-opt change if needed (INC-4587-RCA).
- Aj -> keep dashboards up and increase alert sensitivity if we see any uptick.
- June -> update runbook with the new immediate mitigations and add a checklist for support to communicate to trial tenants.
- Maria -> monitor for 2 hours, then close incident if stable.

Maria Chen: Notes for the handoff to incoming shift: primary contact is me (pager), secondary is Aj Patel. If paging fails escalate to Samir (SRE lead). Pager numbers and rotation pinned in #oncall-rotations.

Maria Chen: Emergency playbook snippets (put in runbook):
```text
If kv_eviction_rate > 1.0/s for >3m:
  1) Increase autoscaler minReplicas by +20% immediately.
  2) Temporarily add fast-fallback routing to smaller model variant (route tag: fallback-small).
  3) If still failing, cordon node(s) with highest eviction rates and shift traffic away.
  4) Notify Support and Execs if >1% total error rate or >3 paid customers impacted.
```

Samir Ortiz: I'll start collecting heap and mem profs from the busiest pods, and correlate with the mem-optimization PR (link: https://phabricator.redwood/MP-879). Will post logs to the incident timeline.

Aj Patel: I'll hold primary monitoring until 09:00 UTC and then hand to the afternoon team. Will run synthetic traffic check in 30m to validate tail latencies.

Maria Chen: Support note (to paste in ticket): "We experienced a short kv-cache eviction incident leading to elevated latencies and intermittent 5xx for a small percentage of requests between 03:12-03:30 UTC. Mitigations were applied (autoscale + fallback routing) and service is stable. Engineering is investigating root cause; we'll update by EOD."

June Park: Anything else to add?

Aj Patel: :thumbsup: all clear from my side. I'll call out if anything flares.

Maria Chen: OK handoff complete. Incoming shift: please ack this thread and escalate immediately if any alert pages. I'll be around for questions until 08:00 UTC. :eyes:

Aj Patel: ACK — incoming shift noted.

Samir Ortiz: ACK — will post RCA draft once I have memory profiles and initial root cause validated (~4-6h).

ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-4587 status updated -> MONITORING. Pages silenced for this incident.

Maria Chen: +1 closing notes: retained logs and timeline in the incident tracker. Leaving todos in the incident board (link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-4587).
